newsitem.title: UK: LME copper holds above $2,270, nickel off peak.
newsitem.headline: LME copper holds above $2,270, nickel off peak.

text.p: COPPER - Holding firmer levels above $2,270 after early push higher ahead of stocks data showing 2,125-tonne decline.
ALUMINIUM - Barely higher, above $1,550 after 1,675-tonne stocks fall.
NICKEL - Volatile. Off early $7,350 peak after stocks rise by 1,872 tonnes.
ZINC - Little changed after stocks fall by 1,650 tonnes.
LEAD - Slightly firmer. TIN - Little changed.
